claims.text: Paradisus Cancun is an all-inclusive resort in Cancun's Hotel Zone, one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations.

findings.quote: Paradisus Cancún delivers exactly what many travelers seek from an all-inclusive: convenience, variety, and fewer out-of-pocket expenses in one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations
Cancun’s official Zona Hotelera (Hotel Zone)

claims.text: The resort opened in 1989 as Gran Melia Cancun and welcomed Spain's royal family two years later.

findings.quote: when it opened in 1989 as Gran Meliá Cancún, even welcoming Spain's royal family just two years later

claims.text: Paradisus Cancun reopened in April 2026 following an extensive renovation.

findings.quote: Paradisus Cancún, which reopened in April 2026 following an extensive renovation

claims.text: Triangular atriums light an open-air design inspired by local cenotes, with live vines cloaking the hallways from the top floor down.

findings.quote: Triangular atriums illuminate an open-air design inspired by local cenotes, in which live vines cloak concentric hallways from the top floor down

claims.text: The guest rooms were redesigned in a palette of white, cream and warm woods, accented by woven macrame wall art.

findings.quote: have been completely redesigned in a calming palette of white, cream, and warm woods, accented by woven macramé wall art

claims.text: The beds face floor-to-ceiling glass toward the balcony.

findings.quote: the beds look straight through floor-to-ceiling glass toward the balcony

claims.text: The resort has four pools and the signature YHI Spa.

findings.quote: four lavish pools and the signature YHI Spa

claims.text: An Eco Spa with Eastern architecture, bamboo and bonsai trees offers Balinese aromatic massage and traditional Thai massage.

findings.quote: An authentic Eco Spa dressed in Eastern architecture, bamboo and bonsai trees transports you across the globe as you enjoy a calming Balinese aromatic massage or traditional Thai massage

claims.text: Family Concierge rooms come with luxury amenities for kids and parents.

findings.quote: Family Concierge is designed for families to spend time together as the rooms come with luxury amenities for kids and parents alike

claims.text: The resort's new spaces include a new water park.

findings.quote: The new spaces in Paradisus Cancun feature a new water park

claims.text: Activities include sushi workshops, wine tastings, pool parties and yoga classes.

findings.quote: including sushi workshops, wine tastings, pool parties and yoga classes

claims.text: The resort has nine restaurants, seven bars, an artisan gelato shop and a Nespresso cafe.

findings.quote: Between nine restaurants, seven bars, an artisan gelato shop, and a Nespresso café
Nine restaurants and seven bars

claims.text: The resort is spread across five interconnected glass-topped pyramids inspired by Mayan legend and structural geometry.

findings.quote: Spread across five interconnected glass-topped pyramids inspired by Mayan legend and structural geometry

claims.text: Every furnished balcony has an unobstructed view of either the Caribbean Sea or Nichupte Lagoon, regardless of room category.

findings.quote: every furnished balcony enjoys an unobstructed view of either the Caribbean Sea or Nichupté Lagoon, regardless of category

claims.text: YHI Spa is a full-service indoor spa with body and facial treatments made with Mexican honey, local ingredients and essential oils.

findings.quote: YHI Spa is a full-service, indoor spa that treats you exceptionally well with body and facial treatments created with Mexican honey, local ingredients and essential oils

claims.text: The Reserve is a setting for adults, with its own pool, restaurant, cafe and dedicated concierge service.

findings.quote: an adults-only setting with its own pool, restaurant, café, dedicated concierge service

findings.quote: a sunset cruise through Cancún's Nichupté Lagoon, exclusively for The Reserve and Family Concierge guests

claims.text: The Play District and the Kanna beach club are not included in the all-inclusive rate.

findings.quote: Older kids and adults can head to the Play District
Just know that these attractions aren't included in the all-inclusive rate. Same goes for Kanna, the property's stylish beach club
